title: Ninit Grants
tagline: A custom grant stack to more easily customize and adapt a grant stack for a communities specific needs and desires, integrating $NOUNs mutable token for QF..
description: This project combines components of Scaffold-Eth-2 and takes inspiration from Allo V1 creating a "Scaffold-Grant-Stack" a fully composable UI with automatically generated webhooks and contracts making it much more easy to understand, and build your own grant stack application with QF, and impact measurement protocols, and accountability mechanisms to hold grantees accountable. This QF grant stacks accepts $NOUNs as donations enhancing the use cases for NOUNs, bringing the community their very own custom QF grant stack where Noun holders can be specially selected to manage the round, or round participants can be limited to NFT holders.
how_its_made: Scaffold-eth-2 is the UI that showcases grant stack applications. Users can create rounds or projects, and fund either as well. Data regarding projects is relayed and read from IPFS for speed, and posted on chain as well, and the application can be redeployed to over 100 chains through yarn deploy. We hard coded the $NOUNs token into the QF grant stack and used Allo v1 and scaffold eth to create one of the first successful iterations of forking Allo v1 contracts into a new and simplified UI.
